subs.group: Ars antiqua: motets of the Montpellier Codex
subs.note: Thirteenth-century motets from the seventh and eighth fascicles of the Montpellier Codex (Montpellier, Bibliothèque interuniversitaire, H 196): a tenor from chant, a motetus and a triplum, each with its own text.

items.desc: Anonymous, A maistre iehan / Pour la plus / Alleluya. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot. The tenor is a chant melody laid out in a repeated rhythm.
